rationale: This role owns the strategic direction and market positioning of HP's Large Format Printing portfolio (Latex, Stitch, DesignJet, Latex R series). With HP actively marketing outdoor durability, UV resistance, and 'graphics that withstand the test of time,' the VP of Product Management is responsible for ecosystem partnerships that enhance the value proposition of HP printer solutions. Tedlar represents a strategic opportunity to differentiate HP's printing systems by offering a validated, premium overlaminate solution that extends the lifespan of HP-printed graphics from 3-5 years to 12-20+ years. This role cares about: (1) Complete solution selling - moving beyond hardware to consumables and finishing materials that drive higher customer lifetime value, (2) Competitive differentiation in a commoditizing printer market, (3) Customer success metrics - reducing warranty claims and customer complaints about premature graphic failure, (4) Channel partner enablement - equipping HP's print service provider customers with materials that justify premium pricing. Given HP's recent launches (Latex 700/800 with white ink, Latex R530 hybrid) and active presence at FESPA, ISA Sign Expo, and PRINTING United, this role is actively seeking partnership opportunities that strengthen HP's market position in outdoor graphics applications.

This role within HP's Large Format Printing division is responsible for identifying and executing strategic partnerships with materials suppliers, finishing solution providers, and ecosystem partners that complement HP's printer technology. The Director of Business Development would evaluate Tedlar as a co-marketing and technical validation partner to create bundled solutions for HP's customer base of sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers. This role's KPIs include: (1) Revenue growth through ecosystem expansion - creating new revenue streams by connecting HP customers with validated materials partners, (2) Customer retention - ensuring HP customers achieve successful outcomes that drive repeat printer purchases and consumables revenue, (3) Market penetration in premium segments - targeting high-value applications where durability and longevity justify higher total solution costs, (4) Competitive win rates against Canon, Epson, and Roland large-format systems. With HP exhibiting at major industry events and launching new outdoor-focused printer models, this role is actively pursuing partnerships that position HP as the complete solution provider for durable outdoor graphics, making Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan a compelling differentiator for HP's sales messaging.

This role within HP's Large Format Printing business unit owns the go-to-market strategy, customer education, and value proposition messaging for HP's outdoor graphics and signage printer portfolio. HP already markets 'outdoor durability,' 'graphics that withstand the test of time,' and 'white ink that resists yellowing'—messaging that directly aligns with Tedlar's value propositions. The VP of Marketing would be interested in Tedlar as a case study and co-marketing partner to substantiate HP's durability claims with third-party validated data. This role cares about: (1) Proof points and customer success stories - demonstrating measurable ROI for HP customers who use validated finishing materials, (2) Thought leadership and industry positioning - establishing HP as the authority on durable outdoor graphics through educational content and technical partnerships, (3) Lead generation at industry events - creating compelling booth experiences and content at FESPA, ISA Sign Expo, and PRINTING United that attract high-value prospects, (4) Customer adoption and satisfaction scores - ensuring HP customers achieve the performance outcomes promised in marketing materials. A partnership with Tedlar would enable HP Marketing to create technical guides, durability comparison studies, and co-branded content that differentiates HP printing systems in competitive evaluations, while providing tangible evidence that HP-printed graphics with Tedlar overlaminates deliver industry-leading outdoor performance.
